summary: Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry table gives ordinary passport holders of, for example, Germany, France, the United States, the United Kingdom and China visa-free stays of up to 30 days, and citizens of Russia, Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan up to 90 days. Tourist electronic visas are issued to citizens of the states on its e-visa list, through the Visa and Migration Portal, in accordance with a valid invitation from the Kazakh side.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Kazakhstan?
faq.answer: It depends on your passport. Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry table gives ordinary passport holders of, for example, Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Japan and China visa-free stays of up to 30 days, and citizens of Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Mongolia and Turkey, among others, up to 90 days. Tourist electronic visas are issued to citizens of the states on the Ministry's list through the Visa and Migration Portal, in accordance with a valid invitation from the Kazakh side.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Kazakhstan visa-free?
faq.answer: Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry table gives ordinary passport holders of, for example, Germany, the United States, the United Kingdom and China up to 30 days. Other allowances differ: up to 90 days for citizens of Russia, Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan and of Albania, Andorra, Saint Kitts and Nevis, San Marino and Turkey; up to 60 days for the Dominican Republic; up to 28 days for Barbados; and up to 14 days for India, Iran, Hong Kong and Macao. The UK government tells British nationals they can visit without a visa for up to 30 days, but must not stay more than 90 days without a visa in any 180-day period.

faq.question: Do I need to register after arriving in Kazakhstan?
faq.answer: The UK government says your hotel or the person hosting you must register your arrival with the Kazakh authorities within 3 working days of your arrival. Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry says foreign citizens who have valid electronic visas are exempted from registration in migration authorities.

faq.question: How does the Kazakhstan eVisa work?
faq.answer: Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry says the electronic visa is issued through the Visa and Migration Portal (vmp.gov.kz) in accordance with a valid invitation from the Kazakh side: you register on the portal, enter the invitation number sent by the inviting side, pay the consular fee online and print the visa. The consular fee for a single tourist visa is 60 US dollars. A tourist eVisa is issued with a single entry for up to 90 days and the right to stay no more than 30 days, and the Ministry's page says eVisa holders can enter and exit only through the checkpoints of the international airports of Nur-Sultan and Almaty; the Embassy in Washington's January 2026 notice says only through border crossing points of the international airports of Kazakhstan.

faq.question: Can Russian and other CIS citizens enter Kazakhstan without a visa?
faq.answer: Yes. Kazakhstan's Foreign Ministry table lists visa-free stays of up to 90 days for ordinary passport holders of Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Moldova, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan; for Armenia and Azerbaijan it gives up to 90 days within 180 days.

tips.host-registration.text: Your hotel or the person hosting you must register your arrival with the Kazakh authorities. They must do this within 3 working days of your arrival in Kazakhstan.

tips.ride-hailing.text: To avoid accidentally using an unlicenced taxi or being overcharged, avoid flagging down taxis and use licensed pre-ordered taxi services whenever possible.

entryRequirements.passportValidity.text: To enter Kazakhstan, your passport must be valid for at least 30 days from the date you arrive and have at least one blank page.
If you have a visa for Kazakhstan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after your visa’s expiry date.

entryRequirements.vaccinations.yellow-fe.text: 8 Includes requirement of proof of vaccination against yellow fever for travellers having transited through the airport of a country determined by WHO to be at risk for yellow fever transmission, regardless of the duration of the transit.
To enter Kazakhstan, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entryRequirements.travelInsurance.text: The medical facilities in Kazakhstan are not as advanced as in the UK. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of medical treatment or evacuation by air ambulance and repatriation.

entryRequirements.declarations.migration.text: Your hotel or the person hosting you must register your arrival with the Kazakh authorities. They must do this within 3 working days of your arrival in Kazakhstan.

entryRequirements.customs.currencyLimits.text: You must declare to customs authorities if you arrive in Kazakhstan with cash of a value greater than 10,000 US dollars.
It is not permitted to export any foreign currency in cash of a value greater than 10,000 US dollars. If such a value is declared it may only be exported in Kazakh tenge.

countryFacts.payments.text: You should carry cash when travelling to rural areas as credit and debit cards may not be as widely accepted as in major cities.

countryFacts.safety.text: Robberies are uncommon in cities and rural areas but do happen.
Avoid walking alone at night and pre-arrange your transport. Do not use unofficial taxis or a taxi already occupied by a passenger.
avoid flagging down taxis and use licensed pre-ordered taxi services whenever possible.

Лица, постоянно или временно проживающие, а также временно пребывающие на территории Республики Казахстан, допускаются к управлению транспортными средствами на основании национальных водительских удостоверений, а при отсутствии таковых – на основании действительных международных или иностранных национальных водительских удостоверений при соблюдении условий и ограничений, перечисленных в пунктах 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 и 19 настоящей статьи.

Выданное в иностранном государстве международное водительское удостоверение признается действительным при условии, что оно предъявляется вместе с соответствующим национальным водительским удостоверением.
Иностранное водительское удостоверение, не соответствующее требованиям международных договоров Республики Казахстан, признается недействительным.
